patterns.message: Surface isolation: @/ipc is a surface-AGNOSTIC event bridge slice. It must NOT import from any apps/* (apps/cli, apps/web, apps/tauri, apps/agent, apps/bench, apps/eval, apps/probe). Surface entries depend on @/ipc, never the reverse. ENV/argv/HTTP/IPC parsing belongs in the surface; @/ipc takes plain typed config and injected transports.

Surface coupling: @/ipc is surface-agnostic. CLI-specific node modules (readline / readline/promises / tty / repl) are terminal-only and belong in apps/cli. Accept a port (StdioReader / StdioWriter) and let the surface inject the concrete implementation.

Surface coupling: named imports from node:process (env, argv, stdin, stdout, stderr, …) are a literal-rename bypass of the @/ipc surface-agnostic invariant. process.exit / process.on / process.cwd (via the global) remain allowed because they are not surface-coupled. For env/argv/stdio, the surface entry (apps/cli, apps/web, apps/tauri) parses node:process and passes typed config / StdioReader/Writer ports into @/ipc.

paths.@/rules: Slice isolation (RFC 3.1): @/rules is reachable by @/agent only — Layer-2 @/runner must reach rules via @/agent.
paths.@/patch: Slice isolation (RFC 3.1): @/patch is reachable by @/tool/apply-patch + @/agent — Layer-2 @/runner does not touch raw patches.
paths.@/migration: Slice isolation (RFC 3.1): @/migration is a one-off translator slice — Layer-2 @/runner does not own session-format translation.

Surface coupling: @/runner is Layer-2 surface-agnostic. CLI-specific node modules (readline / readline/promises / tty / repl) are terminal-only and belong in apps/cli. Accept a port (PromptSource, InputStream) and let the surface inject the concrete implementation (Node TTY / WebSocket / Tauri command).

Surface coupling: named imports from node:process (env, argv, stdin, stdout, stderr, …) are a literal-rename bypass of the @/runner surface-agnostic invariant. process.exit / process.on / process.cwd (via the global) remain allowed because they are not surface-coupled. For env/argv/stdio, the surface entry (apps/cli, apps/web, apps/tauri) parses node:process and passes typed config / a WriteSink port into @/runner.

Slice isolation (ADR-0024 export-gap closure): src/apps/cli is the application entrypoint; library slices and external tests must NOT import its internals. CLI helpers live in src/apps/cli/internal.ts and are reachable only from src/apps/cli/** (and the explicitly-allowed CLI unit tests). New cross-slice helpers should land in @/agent or another library slice.

patterns.message: Thin-surface fence (ADR-0303): src/apps/agent must not import other app surfaces. Move shared runtime below src/apps/.
Thin-surface fence (ADR-0303): src/apps/bench must not import other app surfaces. Move shared runtime below src/apps/.
Thin-surface fence (ADR-0303): src/apps/cli must not import other app surfaces. Move shared runtime below src/apps/.

Surface isolation (ADR-0308 / ARCH-07): src/apps/headless is the SECOND consumer that proves the host layer is reusable. It MUST NOT import from src/apps/cli/**, src/apps/bench/**, or src/apps/agent/** — every env/argv/terminal-bound helper is injected through the dep bundle from @/host/bootstrap.
Surface coupling: src/apps/headless is a non-TTY surface. CLI-specific node modules (readline / tty / repl) belong in apps/cli.

Surface isolation (ADR-0299 host/bootstrap-host-extraction): @/host/bootstrap is the surface-agnostic session bootstrap. It MUST NOT import from any apps/* (apps/cli, apps/web, apps/tauri, apps/agent, apps/bench). Surface entries depend on @/host/bootstrap, never the reverse. Every env/argv/terminal-bound helper is injected via SessionBootstrapDeps.
Surface coupling: @/host/bootstrap is surface-agnostic. CLI-specific node modules (readline / tty / repl) belong in apps/cli. Inject a port instead.
Thin-surface fence (ADR-0303): src/apps/eval must not import other app surfaces. Move shared runtime below src/apps/.
Grounding normalization seam: structural normalization must remain authority-only. Heuristic lexical repair belongs in normalization/heuristic.ts.
Thin-surface fence (ADR-0303): src/apps/probe must not import other app surfaces. Move shared runtime below src/apps/.
Thin-surface fence (ADR-0303): src/apps/cli/repl must not grow private session-assembler shims. Use the sanctioned runner-owned modules instead.

paths.@/agent/tier1/reviewer-subagent: ADR-0299: src/apps/cli/repl/** must NOT import the reviewer subagent module directly. The reviewer factories (materializeReviewerAgent / createSubagentBackedGuardianReview) are injected via SessionBootstrapDeps from @/host/bootstrap and forwarded through the boot result. Import them from src/apps/cli/repl.ts (outside this slice) and pass through the dep bundle.

patterns.message: ADR-0306 (CLI-03): surface registry MUST stay surface-only. It owns slash commands whose body never touches the live LLM, the agent loop, the runner, or the host. Per-command modules (./*-cmd.ts) may import @/agent / @/llm for types, but the registry file itself imports them as opaque SlashCommand objects only. Session-bound commands belong in ./slash/registry-session.ts; app/system commands belong in ./slash/registry-app.ts.
